import sys

from offline_discovery.rule_generate import extract_fragments, _interval_bounds
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import calibrate

fails = 0
def eq(name, got, want):
    global fails
    if got != want:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL', name, 'got', got, 'want', want)
    else:
        print('ok', name)

# --- high-run test: value == mean+std is NOT high (strict)
# row: act [0,2] over real prefix: mean 1, var 1, std 1 -> 2 > 2? no -> no runs
rows = [{'class': 0, 'values': [10, 20], 'activation': [0, 2]}]
certs, meta = extract_fragments(rows, 2)

rows = [{'class': 0, 'values': [10, 20], 'activation': [0, 3]}]
certs, meta = extract_fragments(rows, 2)
eq('strict-no-run-2', certs, [])

# act [0,4]: mean 2, var 4, std 2 -> 4 > 4? no
rows = [{'class': 0, 'values': [10, 20], 'activation': [0, 4]}]
certs, meta = extract_fragments(rows, 2)
eq('strict-no-run-3', certs, [])

# act [0,5]: mean 2.5, var 6.25, std 2.5 -> 5 > 5? no  (mean+std = max for n=2)
rows = [{'class': 0, 'values': [10, 20], 'activation': [0, 5]}]
certs, meta = extract_fragments(rows, 2)
